add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.title: Add Multi-Line Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-multi-line-text-watermark-facade.description: Shows how to create a multi-line text watermark using WatermarkArtifact and apply it to every page of a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.title: Rotate Text Stamp 45 Degrees in PDF
rotate-text-stamp-45-degrees.description: Shows how to rotate a text stamp by 45 degrees around its center and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.title: Apply Image Stamp as Background to All PDF Pages
apply-pdf-page-stamp-as-background.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create an ImageStamp, set it as a background, and add it to every page before saving.

apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.title: Apply External PDF Stamp to Page 3
apply-external-pdf-template-stamp.description: Demonstrates creating a stamp from an external PDF template and overlaying it on the third page of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.title: Add Lower‑Roman Page Numbers to Odd Pages
add-lower-roman-page-numbers-odd-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add lower‑case Roman numeral page numbers to only the odd pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.title: Add Logo and Text Stamps to PDF
combine-image-text-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to create an ImageStamp and a TextStamp, configure their appearance and placement, and apply both stamps to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-header-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through its Pages collection, and add a centered header TextStamp to each page using Aspose.Pdf before saving the result.

add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.title: Add Footer Date Stamp to Last PDF Page
add-footer-date-stamp-to-last-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to insert a footer stamp containing the current date (MM-dd-yyyy) on the last page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotating Image Stamp to PDF Pages
apply-rotating-stamps-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add an image stamp to each page of a PDF and rotate it according to the page index.

add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.title: Add Background Text Watermark to Selected PDF Pages
add-background-watermark-to-specific-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a semi‑transparent background text stamp and apply it to pages 2‑5 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Multi‑Line Watermark to PDFs
batch-add-multi-line-watermark-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files and apply the same multi‑line text watermark to every page using Aspose.Pdf's high‑level API.

add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.title: Apply Image Stamp to PDFs and Save to New Directory
add-image-stamp-to-pdfs-preserve-filenam.description: Shows how to load PDF files from a folder, add an image stamp to every page, and write the stamped PDFs to another folder while preserving the original file names.

overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.title: Overlay Disclaimer PDF on First Page
overlay-legal-disclaimer-with-pdffilesta.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Stamp and PdfFileStamp to overlay a disclaimer PDF onto the first page of a target PDF and save the stamped document.

apply-translucent-text-watermark.title: Add Translucent Image Watermark to PDF
apply-translucent-text-watermark.description: Shows how to place a 50% opacity image stamp as a watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Image Stamp to Bottom-Right of PDF Pages
apply-rotated-image-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating an ImageStamp, rotating it 30°, aligning it to the bottom‑right corner of each page, and saving the stamped document.

add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Page Number Stamp to PDF
add-page-number-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextStamp with the {page_number} placeholder, apply it to every page of a PDF, and save the stamped document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.title: Add Multi‑Line Watermark with Custom Font to PDF
add-multi-line-watermark-custom-font.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a memory stream and applying a multi‑line watermark with a custom font size, color, and opacity to every page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.title: Add Footer Image Stamp 10 Points Above Bottom Edge
add-footer-stamp-10-points-above-bottom.description: The example loads a PDF, creates an ImageStamp configured as a footer, sets its vertical alignment to bottom with a 10‑point bottom margin, and applies it to every page before saving.

apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to Even Pages of a PDF
apply-stamp-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add an image stamp only to even-numbered pages of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.title: Add QR Code and Verification Text Stamp to PDF
qr-code-and-text-stamp-for-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an ImageStamp for a QR code and a TextStamp for verification instructions, positioning them on each page, and saving the stamped document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to Specific PDF Pages
apply-text-stamp-to-specific-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image stamp to pages 1, 5, and 10 of a PDF by directly accessing page indices using Aspose.Pdf.

overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Overlay Image Stamp on PDF Pages
overlay-image-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply an image stamp as an overlay (Background = false) to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.title: Add Transparent Confidential Text Stamp to Selected PDF Pages
add-transparent-confidential-text-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to apply a semi‑transparent 'CONFIDENTIAL' text stamp with 70% opacity to specific pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

custom-font-stamp-branding.title: Add Custom Font Text Stamp to PDF
custom-font-stamp-branding.description: Demonstrates loading a TrueType font and applying a branded text stamp to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.title: Add Page Number Stamp with Leading Zeros to PDF
add-page-number-stamp-leading-zeros.description: Demonstrates how to add a page‑number stamp formatted with leading zeros to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.title: Batch Apply Rotated Text Stamp to PDFs
batch-apply-rotated-pdf-stamp.description: Demonstrates loading multiple PDF files from a network share, adding a 45‑degree rotated "CONFIDENTIAL" text stamp to every page, and saving the stamped documents with a new name.

multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.title: Add Multi-Line Watermark with Different Font Styles
multi-line-watermark-addnewlinetext.description: Demonstrates how to apply a three‑line watermark to each page of a PDF, using a different font style for each line.

add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Right-Aligned Logo Stamp to PDF Pages
add-right-aligned-logo-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp (logo) at the right‑hand side of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf. The stamp's HorizontalAlignment is set to Right and applied to all pages.

apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.title: Add Semi‑Transparent PNG Background Stamp to PDF
apply-semi-transparent-png-background-st.description: Demonstrates how to apply a semi‑transparent PNG image as a background stamp that covers the entire area of each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-creation-date-stamp.title: Add Creation Date Stamp to PDF
add-creation-date-stamp.description: Shows how to read a PDF's creation date and place it as a text stamp on the top‑left corner of every page using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-cover-page-background.title: Merge Cover Page as Background Using PdfFileStamp
merge-cover-page-background.description: Shows how to bind a cover PDF page as a background stamp and apply it to another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, resulting in a merged document.

add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.title: Add Logo and Confidential Stamps to PDF
add-confidential-text-and-logo-stamp.description: Loads a PDF, adds an image stamp for a company logo and a bold red "Confidential" text stamp to each page, then saves the stamped document.

apply-custom-line-height-stamp.title: Apply Multi-Line Watermark with Custom Line Height
apply-custom-line-height-stamp.description: Shows how to add several TextStamp watermarks to a PDF page and control the vertical spacing between them using a custom line height.

rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.title: Rotate Image Stamp 90° and Verify Text Readability
rotate-text-stamp-on-pdf-pages.description: The example creates an ImageStamp, sets its RotateAngle to 90 degrees, applies it to each page of a PDF, saves the result, and then extracts text to confirm the original content remains readable.

add-footer-with-page-count.title: Add Footer Stamp with Page Count to PDF
add-footer-with-page-count.description: Demonstrates how to add a footer text stamp that automatically displays the current page number and total page count on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF Stamp by Merging PDFs
combine-multiple-pdfs-into-multi-page-st.description: Merges several PDF files into a single document and adds a header stamp that appears on every page of the combined PDF.

add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.title: Apply Custom Border Stamp to PDF Pages
add-custom-border-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a text annotation with a custom border thickness and color to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.title: Batch Add Rotated Image Stamp to PDFs
batch-add-rotated-image-stamp-to-first-p.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files in a directory and apply a rotated image stamp to the first page of each document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Apply Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
apply-image-stamp-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a single ImageStamp, and efficiently add that stamp to every page using Page.AddStamp, then save the stamped document.

add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add File Name Header Stamp to PDF
add-file-name-header-stamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a header stamp that displays the PDF's file name using the {file_name} placeholder (or manual replacement) with Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.title: Add Background Image Stamp with 30% Opacity
add-semi-transparent-background-stamp.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp as a background on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, setting the stamp opacity to 30% to keep the document readable.

add-multi-line-text-watermark.title: Add Multi-Line Watermark with Varying Font Sizes
add-multi-line-text-watermark.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over each page, and adds three centered text fragments as a watermark, each using a different font size to create visual hierarchy.

stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.title: Add Dynamic Barcode Stamp to PDF Pages
stamp-pdf-with-dynamic-barcode.description: Demonstrates how to generate a barcode image from a document's unique identifier and apply it as an ImageStamp on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.title: Apply Rotated Text Stamp to Odd Pages
apply-rotated-text-stamp-odd-pages.description: Shows how to add a 30‑degree rotated text stamp to the left margin of every odd‑numbered page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Text Stamp to PDF
add-dynamic-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextStamp with the current date and author using string interpolation, apply the stamp to every page, and save the modified document.

add-repeating-background-watermark-image.title: Add Background Image Stamp to All PDF Pages
add-repeating-background-watermark-image.description: Demonstrates how to create a single ImageStamp and reuse it to apply a semi‑transparent background watermark image to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.title: Add Multi-Line Colored Header Stamp to PDF
add-multi-line-colored-header-stamp.description: Shows how to apply a multi-line header stamp to each page of a PDF, with each line displayed in a different font color using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-barcode-stamp-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Barcode Stamp to PDF Pages
add-header-barcode-stamp-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to generate a barcode image and place it as a header stamp on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-line-text-stamp-with-line-spac.title: Add Multi-Line Text Stamp with 1.5 Line Spacing
add-multi-line-text-stamp-with-line-spac.description: Loads a PDF, creates a multi-line TextStamp, configures font, size, style, color and a line spacing of 1.5, then applies the stamp to every page and saves the watermarked document.
